svg.title: Where the six audit findings sat
svg.desc: The path an email takes, from the person checking it to the website, the worker, the result check and scoring, with a second path for a profile picture. Finding 1, Medium: a route parsed header text inside the website, removed on 17 October 2026. Finding 2, Low: the daemon was trusted when a kernel filter setting was present, instead of when it was correct. Finding 3, Low: the host read only the first and last bytes of the picture, and the worker copied a colour profile from the upload. Finding 4, Low in the isolation report, Medium in the merged audit: a message that stopped the worker was reported as an outage. Finding 5, Medium: padding a message was enough to get no verdict. Finding 6, Low: not a bug, the guard saw the dangerous XML construct in all 258 encodings the reader accepted. Five were fixed between 16 and 17 October 2026; the sixth was not a bug.
